sections.label: 1 - A BID GOES OUT
sections.note: The website form fires the sequence and the bid is tracked as an opportunity.

sections.label: 2 - FOUR TIMED TOUCHES
sections.note: Text and email alternate on day 1, 3, 7 and 14. Business hours only.

sections.label: 3 - NO ANSWER
sections.note: After the last touch the bid is marked cold so nobody chases it by hand.

sections.label: 4 - THE MOMENT THEY REPLY
sections.note: The goal jumps any replier here, whatever day it is. The owner is told immediately.

nodes.label: 3 - Open the Bid in the Pipeline
5 - Text: Did You Get the Bid

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, this is {{user.first_name}} with {{location.name}}. Just making sure the bid we sent over came through. Any questions on it? Happy to walk you through the numbers.

nodes.label: 7 - Email: Quick Recap of Your Bid

params.subject: Quick recap of your bid, {{contact.first_name}}
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, wanted to make this easy to find. Your bid from {{location.name}} is attached to this thread. If the scope or timing needs adjusting, reply here and I will rework it the same day. {{user.first_name}}

nodes.label: 9 - Text: Still Want to Move Forward

params.message: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, {{user.first_name}} again. Our schedule for the next few weeks is filling up. If you want to lock in your spot on the bid we sent, just reply here and I will get you on the calendar.

params.subject: Last check in on your project
params.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, I will stop following up after this one so I am not a pest. If the project is still on, the bid stands and I can start whenever you are ready. If it is on hold, no problem at all, just let me know and I will check back in a few months. {{user.first_name}}

nodes.label: 12 - Move the Bid to No Response
14 - Goal: Customer Replied to the Bid
nodes.notes: The companion workflow adds bid-replied the moment the customer replies on any channel, so a reply on day 2 skips every remaining touch and lands here.

params.to: the contact's assigned user, and if none is assigned, all users
params.message: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} just replied about their bid. Open the conversation and answer while it is warm: {{contact.phone}}

params.to: the contact's assigned user, and if none is assigned, all users
params.subject: Bid reply from {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}}
params.message: {{contact.first_name}} {{contact.last_name}} replied to the bid follow-up. Phone {{contact.phone}}, email {{contact.email}}. Open the conversation in GoHighLevel to answer.
